section.title: Completing the Square
section.para: When a number is added to a quadratic expression to make a perfect square trinomial, that is called completing the square.
Here is how to complete the square of a quadratic expression, \(ax^2+bx+c\).

section.para: Complete the square to make a perfect square trinomial. Then write the result as a binomial squared.

Step 1 - Identify \(b\), the coefficient of \(x\).
The coefficient of \(x\) is -26.

Step 2 - Find half of \(b\) and then square it. In other words, \((\frac{b}{2})^2\).
\((-\frac{26}{2})^2=(-13)^2=169\)

Step 4 - Factor the perfect square trinomial, writing it as a binomial squared.
\((x-13)^2\)
